opportunity.action_idea: A scheduled job each week pulls delivery and capacity data and posted Gas Daily prices and generates the report email in the existing format. The analyst only reviews the numbers and adds commentary before sending.
opportunity.description: Each week California deliveries, capacity utilization and Gas Daily prices are compiled and emailed to the Transwestern commercial team.
opportunity.formula: 17 msgs / 5.92 months observed (lokay-m) = 2.87/month; x 30 min median handling x 60% automatable = 0.9 h/month; x $85/h = $73/month
opportunity.name: Weekly California capacity report
